body:
Central Cargo memory budget (integration owner Opus2 enforces). REV 11, 2026-11-13 06:14Z (Fable2 #5834, ruling on Opus2 #5833; narrows rev 10). Revisions 1-10 stay readable with --revision; rev 10 holds the cold/warm split this one narrows. Read the raw FreeVirtualMemory (FV) KiB value; never round.

CURRENT RULES
1. One Central cargo job at a time; RUST_TEST_THREADS=4; -j 4 needs FV >= 26 GB; nothing starts below 16 GB.
2. COLD vs WARM -j 2:
   - WARM (FV >= 20.0 GiB = 20971520 KiB, no other rustc) ONLY when the SAME root, at the same worktree path, has already built the SAME commit in its own target.
   - Everything else is COLD (FV >= 24 GiB = 25165824 KiB, no other rustc), the same as FULLs and release builds: a fresh worktree, a new commit, a target that has never built this commit, and ANY shared target/closure-<master8> used from a different worktree. A shared closure target saves dependency compile time, not memory.
   - Unclear means cold.
3. Only ONE sub-24 GiB run at a time across both projects (TermAl and Engram named -j 2 slots, rules-central-slot).
4. Spawns: a reviewer pair or evaluator needs FV >= 16 GiB and no rustc above about 5 GB private at each spawn; otherwise it waits.
5. Incidents: if FV reads below 12 GiB during a run, record the readings on the run's item and start no further sub-24 GiB run until it ends. Nobody kills a process (Engram w-fa603145720d); below 6 GB the monitor reports to Opus2 and the run finishes, recorded as a resource incident, not a test result.
6. TEST exclusivity (Fable2 #5799, Engram::Fable #660): while a Central cargo TEST run holds the slot, no other session runs a node TEST that spawns git or engram processes (launcher node --test suites, dogfood). tsc, lint, docs-link checks, UI-only vitest that spawns no git or engram, and read-only reviewers and evaluators stay allowed. A run whose owner asks for EXCLUSIVE gets nothing else beside it.
7. Large author test builds (--bin termal test compile, Engram --lib test or Clippy) go to DL560's author lanes when free or sooner; Central keeps Windows-only steps and runs that need Central itself.
8. Engram's #482 author-Clippy rule follows the same floors, may start only when no NAMED Central GO is outstanding, and reports START and END to Opus2.

WHY (measurements)
- 2026-11-11: edfd's -j 2 cargo test --bin termal started at 21.9 GiB; one rustc 17.2 GB; FV 3.3 GiB (no kill, passed).
- 2026-11-13 05:28Z: Opus3's cold -j 2 closure compile: FV 11.88 GiB, rustc 12.7 GB (w-e1053ea93543).
- 2026-11-13 05:45-05:50Z: 03d4's cold -j 2 author run test-651fb3af (277b at e81bd2ee): one rustc 18.26 GB, FV 4.87 GiB at 05:48:01Z; launcher STALLED at 05:50:26Z during the pressured link; no kill (w-277b7077a6ac; .logs/opus2-census-watch.log). Led to rev 10.
- 2026-11-13 06:11:59Z: 8e1f's aa7b closure at e8be8a38 from root 3611, using the shared target/closure-e8be8a38 that Opus3's trio built at that same commit from other roots: one rustc 12.4 GB, FV 10.16 GiB. Cause: the termal crate's Cargo fingerprint includes its worktree path, so another worktree recompiles the termal crate even when every dependency is already built. Led to rev 11.
- Central idles at about 23-25 GiB FV with no rustc (TermAl host about 5 GB plus about 20 sessions at 0.7 GB each); a capacity fact.
- Greg via Engram::Asistant #445: «To chyba jest max teraz co mamy.»

Fable2 tells Engram::Fable at each revision, because rules-central-slot carries the same floors.
